newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says no steel price change seen.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says no steel price change seen.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Friday that it could not see any immediate change in the price received for its steel products.

"In our businesses one of the major drivers and the only thing I can say to you about prices is that in steel they are flat and there are no immediate signs of them changing," managing director John Prescott told reporters.

Prescott, speaking at a news conference after the company released its profit result for the first six months to November 30, was reluctant to predict future prices of other key commodities within the group.
"In copper they are volatile and there is no useful comment you can add to that."
He said metal prices were contracted and would not change until April 1 and it was futile to try and predict petroleum prices.
"Those things that are within our control we are very focussed on."
